text: cal.iterate.forEach dispatches batches on the event queue and returns before iteration finishes. Its completed callback runs on exhaustion or BREAK. The removed require-jsdoc directive is only lint compatibility; the scheduling contract remains. Do not treat this helper as Array.prototype.forEach or replace it mechanically with a synchronous loop. No scheduling test ran.
title: Calendar’s yielding iterator completes through its callback
